subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate homonym to fill in the blank.

Due to the attack his vital organs ________ functioning.
solution:
The correct answer is "**ceased**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the blank will imply how the attack stopped the functioning of the vital organs.
 
• Among the given options, the correct word to use is "ceased."
 
• **"Ceased" means to stop or come to an end, which fits the context of the sentence.**(समाप्त)
